input: DATA-MATH12-011 canonical snapshot + DATA-MATH12-012 candidate curriculum/scoring policy

subject_resolution.rule: Importer must resolve DB Subject by canonical MATH_G12. Treat MATH12 only as historical snapshot metadata; do not query/create Subject MATH12.

identity.idempotency: same external keys must resolve to same UUIDs; re-run is no-op when content/taxonomy matches; drift is a conflict

write_mode.reason: Learning/recommendation engines are Question-centric and not group-aware; approving child Questions would leak them as standalone items.

taxonomy_requirements: all child ProblemType codes resolve under MATH_G12
all child Concept codes resolve under MATH_G12
all child LearningOutcome codes resolve under MATH_G12
taxonomy candidate/content hash matches the reviewed candidate used for preview
visual_requirements: 8 visual groups keep existing visual_asset_id lineage
Question/QuestionGroup DB schema currently has no media attachment; importer stores visual lineage only in import preview/report, not in fake content fields
rights_requirements: DRAFT import is for internal review only
no public asset-serving endpoint is added in this phase
transaction_rules: all four child Questions and parent QuestionGroup created in one transaction
advisory lock on trusted group import in PostgreSQL
exact content/taxonomy revalidation at confirm time
conflict if deterministic UUID already exists with different immutable imported content
